configuration.carrier: Prob(Q) x Prob(Omega) x (Prob(P) x Measure_<=M(P x Q))

G0_CARRIER.obligation: Prove that the selected carrier is adequate for the concrete geometry.

evidence: Declared min scale join and finite-sample union/partition join.
G1_DIRECTED.obligation: Compile the concrete directed-order proof in active Mathlib.

G2_COMPACT.obligation: Prove compact containment, normalization, mass bounds, and closed constraints.

G3_EXTRACT.obligation: Extract a cluster point or convergent subnet only after G2 passes.

G4_CLOSED.obligation: Prove direction, incidence, and quantitative shading closure.

G5_TRANSFER.obligation: Prove continuity or semicontinuity for one named observable.

claim_boundaries: No compactness theorem is established for the proposed carrier.
No convergent subnet is claimed before G2 passes.
No Kakeya admissibility or observable-transfer theorem is established.
Framework L2_C receives no analytic structure from its notation.
No RH, Coleman, or faithful-kappa bridge is changed.
falsifier: A refinement family without common upper bounds or a convergent family whose incidence observable transfers in the wrong direction.
kill_criterion: Abandon the carrier if it loses position-direction-incidence coupling or yields no useful transfer lemma.
